local_review.finding_body: Review Signal #1 requires a new-library change to contain only one target library and its supporting test files, but metadata/org.hibernate.validator/hibernate-validator/7.0.4.Final/reachability-metadata.json was also modified alongside the org.springdoc addition.
local_review.finding_title: New-library change included unrelated library metadata
local_review.fix_note: Restored metadata/org.hibernate.validator/hibernate-validator/7.0.4.Final/reachability-metadata.json to the base revision, leaving the resulting change scoped to org.springdoc:springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui:3.0.3.
local_review.review_comment: Approved after repair. I checked the eventual PR diff for single-library scope, test scaffold/native-execution/version/package/JVM-override rules, metadata file shape, and the recorded coverage evidence. The test exercises the target library through a separate public test package and passes on both JVM and Native Image. The reported dynamic-access result is the valid 0/0 no-calls case, so no percentage or metadata-count mismatch gate applies. Targeted validateIndexFiles, checkMetadataFiles, and test verification passed on the repaired tree.
